capability_defaults.support_notes: Model-specific additions are based on the single-output 24 V, layout 1 / model 0x3501 report in issue #88. Maintainer hardware validation is pending; inherited untested status is retained.

anenji_equalization_enabled.reason: Enable program 33 before requesting a one-shot equalization.

anenji_standby_only.reason: This model accepts nominal output voltage/frequency changes only in Standby.

anenji_user_battery.reason: Program 32 is available with User-defined battery type.

anenji_equalization_battery.reason: Equalization settings apply only to Flooded or User battery type, not lithium.

capabilities.title: Battery Type
capabilities.change_summary: Changes battery chemistry/BMS mode and may reset charge or cut-off settings. Review all related settings after a deliberate change; they are not restored automatically.
capabilities.note: Program 05: issue #88 owner confirmed all six choices through an HA patch declaring FC06, with LCD and register-322 readback, battery disconnected. No wire capture or FC16 comparison was provided. Uses the same enum labels as normal telemetry.
capabilities.support_notes: Owner-observed write/readback with a local patch, not a maintainer hardware test of this built-in overlay. Full Control and explicit entity activation are required; no automatic battery-type change.

capabilities.title: Equalization Now
capabilities.change_summary: Requests one equalization cycle. Only for a suitable Flooded/User battery with equalization enabled; never use for lithium, including a lithium battery configured as User. Acceptance does not confirm a completed cycle.
capabilities.note: Program 39: issue #88 owner observed AdS -> AEN -> AdS on LCD after FC06 to 425 with Flooded selected and program 33 enabled. Battery was disconnected; no completed equalization cycle was tested. This is a one-shot action, not a persistent on/off setting.
capabilities.support_notes: Reported command acceptance only. Retained as untested and opt-in; inherited checks apply to both HA availability and the pre-write refresh.

capabilities.note: Program 01: value 4 (SUF) reported against LCD on the single-output 24 V 0x3501 / protocol 1 unit in issue #88. No mode change is performed automatically.
Program 16: CSO / SNU / OSO reported in issue #88. This model does not expose Utility Priority.
Program 08: discrete LCD choices, writable only in Standby according to issue #88. The numeric measurement remains separate from this selector.
Program 09: discrete LCD choices, writable only in Standby according to issue #88. The numeric measurement remains separate from this selector.

capabilities.title: Automatic Mains Output
capabilities.note: Program 10: nnL / AtO. Reported on the single-output Anenji 4200 in issue #88; Auto can supply utility to the load with the inverter power switch off.

capabilities.title: Constant Voltage to Float Time
capabilities.note: Program 32: 0 = AUT; otherwise 5–900 minutes in 5-minute LCD steps, for User battery type, as reported in issue #88.

capabilities.title: Lithium Automatic Activation
capabilities.note: Program 41: nAL / AtO, reported in issue #88. This is automatic activation, not the unconfirmed program 42 manual-activation command.
Program 43: register and limits reported for the 24 V Li4/BMS setup in issue #88. The inverter also validates dependencies on other SOC thresholds.
Program 44: register and limits reported for the 24 V Li4/BMS setup in issue #88. The inverter also validates dependencies on other SOC thresholds.
Program 45: register and limits reported for the 24 V Li4/BMS setup in issue #88. The inverter also validates dependencies on other SOC thresholds.

capabilities.title: Maximum Discharge Current Protection
capabilities.note: Program 46: 0 = OFF (disables protection). The issue #88 owner reports an LCD selection range of 0-500 A and successful LCD readback at both endpoints. This is a model-specific LCD range, not a documented wire rejection threshold or a recommendation for battery current; values beyond 500 A were not tested.
Program 02: up to 100 A (raw tenths), reported for the single-output 24 V unit in issue #88. Must not be less than utility charge current; the inverter validates the combination.
Program 11: 2–80 A (raw tenths), reported for the single-output 24 V unit in issue #88. Must not exceed total charge current.
